a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the build-to-8 plan gives us both only about a 4% chance of surviving. The reserve holds exactly 4, enough for one unit now. If we both take, the split is random and we likely both fail, so please operate this round. Afterward I'll keep operating with you every round so you can get your 4.
